name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Modular skill set that audits a brand's website for AI-crawler and AI-agent readiness: renderability, content noise, discoverability, structured-data completeness, and crawl-compliance posture.

skills.summary: Entrypoint. Receives the audit request, sequences every capability skill below, and emits the single audit report.
Low-overhead HTTP/DOM inspection without JavaScript execution.
Headless Playwright/Chromium rendering, scroll/interaction driving, and shadow-DOM traversal.
Multi-page internal link scoring and fragmented-information discovery.
Maps raw technical signals to the Web Failure Ontology to produce scored findings.
Aggregates evidence, corroborates findings, runs coverage/validation meta-analysis, and emits the final floor-schema JSON audit report.
